info.name: Maintenance Tools Access
info.description: Which roles can reach the Maintenance tool routes (cache, Redis, JVM information, sessions and threads): only CMS Administrators; everyone else gets 401. Also checks that the two retired DWR scripts are gone, that the JVM information and the cache listing hide secrets, and that the Maintenance page shows its System Info, Threads and Logged Users tabs only to a CMS Administrator.
